chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Ibrahim (peace be upon him) drew a line in Mecca between the Hazwara and the Mas'a, and that is what Ibrahim (peace be upon him) drew, meaning the Mosque."

key_terms.الْحَزْوَرَةِ: A specific location or landmark in Mecca used to define the boundary of the Haram.
key_terms.الْمَسْجَدَ: The Mosque, specifically referring to the Sacred Mosque (Al-Masjid Al-Haram) in this context.
key_terms.الْمَسْعَى: A specific location or landmark in Mecca, often associated with the area of the Sa'i.

ai.seo_question: What are the original boundaries of the Sacred Mosque in Mecca according to Prophet Ibrahim?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the prophetic origin of the Sa'i boundaries, linking the ritual of walking between Safa and Marwa directly to Prophet Ibrahim (AS). It provides the foundational jurisprudential basis for determining the sacred precincts (Haram) and the validity of the Sa'i rite within these delineated limits.
